verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Khoj reached through many clients (Emacs, Obsidian, desktop, web, WhatsApp), but no documented public API and nothing showing parity between API and UI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt. Multiple first-party clients may imply a backend interface, but that is not a documented API capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
